introduction: Care 4 Kids helps eligible Connecticut families pay for child care. Families apply through the Parent Portal and arrange an approved provider agreement.
description: Care 4 Kids helps eligible Connecticut families pay for child care. Families apply through the Parent Portal and arrange an approved provider agreement.

sections.who: Applicants must meet Connecticut residency, income and approved activity rules. The program serves children under 13, or under 19 with special needs. A screening result is not final approval.
sections.get: An approved Child Care Certificate authorizes payment. The amount depends on case details and provider arrangements, and an enrollment list can affect when assistance begins.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Start through the Parent Portal

    Use the eligibility screener and application links at Care 4 Kids.

  2. Arrange the provider paperwork

    You can submit an application before choosing care. Submit the completed Parent-Provider Agreement afterward; a certificate cannot be issued without it.

  3. Check portal action items

    Review notices, application status and requested records. Call 888-214-5437 if you need help with the case.
sections.after: Use the portal for changes and redetermination. Fax service ended in June 2026; the program announces a fully paperless process beginning January 1, 2027.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Family application and provider requirements; Current portal and paperless notices. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

No. Apply first if necessary, then submit the provider agreement.
